description: Adds CardFooter: one muted line after the card's other parts; it throws on a link or a button, which go in CardAside. CardAside styles a link among its always-shown items. CardAction and CardExplain throw inside a hover card, which marks its content with CardHoverOnly. CardFacts takes layout "bullets", one bullet per fact with CardFact's new icon prop; install the bullet item with card.

Component introduced: Card, CardSubject, CardMedia, CardId, CardName, CardDescription, CardLink, CardAside, CardAction, CardFacts, CardFact, CardExplain and CardMissing, moved from the card experiment.
